name: Entangling Shadows
body:
School illusion (shadow) [darkness]; Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a broken lock)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area 10 ft. radius burst
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

When you utter the words for this spell, chains and locks made from shadow writhe into being at a point in range you designate. Creatures in the area that fail a Will save become entangled. They may attempt to free themselves with a Strength or Escape Artist check against the spell’s DC. Either attempt to escape requires a full round action whether it is successful or not. In addition, the affected area is treated as difficult terrain until the beginning of your next turn.
